name: Nina Lindberg
source: A maid who has been serving the Verritti family ever since she was little, and moved into the Oasis building when Carina made the Clan. Nina is very mother-like among the members of the clan, and she always cares for its members. She's the one who manages the quests (and Leicester is the one who chooses which one to actually do). Has an impressive intelligence network.
